title: Brand Standards Schedule: Walked-Stay Extra on Free Night Awards Replacement Validity
content:
Nights booked on a relocated reservation lengthen the validity of a replacement. For a replacement among the Free Night Awards deposited because an award came back from a reservation the hotel relocated after its expiry date had passed, the walked-stay extra reads the nights booked on the relocated reservation, as its Room Reservations record shows them. The walked-stay extra is added to the replacement validity months before the expiry date is worked out.

| Nights booked on the relocated reservation | Walked-stay extra |
|---|---|
| 3 or more (upper walked-stay nights) | 2 months (upper walked-stay extra) |
| 2 (lower walked-stay nights) | 1 month (lower walked-stay extra) |
| 1, a shorter stay | No walked-stay extra |

At least the upper walked-stay nights earn the upper walked-stay extra, at least the lower walked-stay nights the lower walked-stay extra, and a shorter stay nothing.
